articles.title: K1 Exits TechnoMile, a Category-Leading Platform for Government Contractors
articles.mainIdea: K1 Exits TechnoMile, a Category-Leading Platform for Government Contractors
articles.summary: PR Newswire: K1 Exits TechnoMile, a Category-Leading Platform for Government Contractors. K1 Investment Management, LLC ("K1"), a leading investor in small-cap enterprise software powered by AI, today announced that its portfolio company, TechnoMile, a category-leading platform for government contractors, has combined with SIMS Software, an industrial security software provider, in a transaction led by Capitol Meridian Partners. This transaction marks K1's sixth realization in the last 12 months.
